question: 在相同 token、存储和检索预算下，因果关系图记忆是否比向量相似度检索更能提高长程交互任务的事实问答准确率？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Causal structure improves evidence retention across real and synthetic traces.
H2: Gains depend on benchmark construction, retrieval tools, or unmatched computation.
H3: Matched-budget long-context or hybrid memory is equally effective.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: AMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Memory for Agentic Applications
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The benchmark combines real-world trajectories from six domains with synthetic trajectories. Authors report weaknesses in current memory systems and an AMA-Agent gain; benchmark/method co-development motivates independent matched-budget evaluation.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 固定模型、轨迹、总 token 与存储预算，比较向量检索、因果图、混合记忆；在真实与合成轨迹上分层报告准确率、遗忘率和检索成本。

question: 在工具权限、模型和总交互预算相同的条件下，面向单轮攻击设计的防御能否降低多轮自适应攻击的成功率？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Single-turn defenses generalize to multi-turn attacks.
H2: Accumulated state and tool chaining require state-aware defenses.
H3: The result depends on the benchmark's attack generation and environment selection.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: AgentLAB: Benchmarking LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Attacks
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: AgentLAB covers five attack families, 28 environments, and 644 cases; authors report one-shot defenses are not reliably effective across agents and attack types.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 在冻结的多轮攻击集上比较单轮防护、状态跟踪防护和组合防护，使用攻击成功率、误拦率及交互成本作为指标。

question: 在长程环境变化归因任务中，显式累积跨模态证据是否比只使用最终观察或单一模态更早、更准确地识别原因？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Extra modalities provide complementary clues across settings.
H2: Benefits occur mainly in controlled scenes and decline with similar behavior or realism.
H3: Observation length/model capacity, not modality count, drives the result.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: MARPLE: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Inference
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: Performance worsens when agents' mission preferences converge; the paper's two-agent whodunit setup is constrained and authors call for more realistic scenarios.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 用同一批模拟轨迹比较单步、文本、视觉、音频及多模态逐步证据条件，测量达到正确归因所需的最早时间点和校准。

question: 在桌面任务中加入窗口位置、尺寸和无关窗口扰动后，使用显式窗口状态恢复策略能否减少任务成功率下降？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Explicit state recovery prevents coordinate errors from cascading.
H2: Software knowledge and visual grounding dominate, limiting recovery-only gains.
H3: Benchmark failure frequencies may not represent real workflows.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: OSWorld reports mouse-click inaccuracies in over 75% of sampled failures and also describes software-knowledge and environment-noise errors; it does not establish that a recovery policy fixes them.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 冻结 OSWorld 任务和模型，对比基线与带窗口状态检测/恢复模块的 agent，按扰动类型分别测成功率、恢复次数和耗时。

question: 在仓库级软件问题修复中，模型在未见仓库上的通过率是否显著低于随机划分评测，并且差异是否由跨文件依赖和测试要求解释？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Issue/PR-based evaluation predicts performance on unseen projects.
H2: Repository overlap, language coverage, or incomplete tests inflate apparent generalization.
H3: Test pass rate and patch quality are distinct outcomes.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: This SWE-bench version is Python-only; its authors caution that execution tests alone do not guarantee patch quality, readability, or efficiency.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 按仓库留出进行评测，并与常规随机任务划分比较；将任务按跨文件依赖、测试覆盖和 issue 类型预先分层。

question: 对 LLM 生成的代码变更逐步执行语义保持过滤，是否能在不降低有效改进数量的情况下减少回归？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Staged validation removes harmful edits while retaining useful changes.
H2: Incomplete or strict validators miss regressions or reject valid changes.
H3: Apparent gains come from feedback/search rather than assurance filtering.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: Assured LLM-Based Software Engineering
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The paper motivates assurance mechanisms for LLM-generated software changes; the outline-style evidence does not establish broad causal effectiveness.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 对真实历史代码变更做配对评估，比较裸生成、单元测试过滤、性质/差分测试过滤的回归率、有效变更数和成本。

question: 在训练数据来源不同、未见编程语言或未见错误类型上，代码幻觉检测器能否区分看似合理但语义错误的代码？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Detectors learn portable semantic-error signals.
H2: Detection depends on language, library/model, and error taxonomy.
H3: Compiler/type/test checking is more reliable than a learned classifier.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: CodeMirage: Hallucinations in Code Generated by Large Language Models
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The study operationalizes and evaluates code hallucination in selected settings; the definition, sampled models, and tasks limit direct generalization.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 按基础数据集、语言和幻觉类型做留一组外验证，并加入人工审核的真实仓库补丁作为外部测试集。

question: 在漏洞修复中，逐步推理与编译器/测试反馈分别能否提高独立确认的正确补丁率？收益能否推广到更多漏洞类型和较新的项目？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Reasoning plus validation feedback improves secure patches across C/Java.
H2: Gains shrink on newer projects or when patch correctness is independently judged.
H3: The benefit depends on vulnerability class and available test/sanitizer feedback.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: A Case Study of LLM for Automated Vulnerability Repair: Assessing Impact of Reasoning and Patch Validation Feedback
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: VRpilot reports 14% and 7.6% more correct patches than baselines on its C and Java datasets; ablations find reasoning and feedback contribute. Authors note manual correctness judgments are costly and possible training-data leakage.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 对同一漏洞集比较漏洞描述、局部代码、调用图/项目文档三种上下文，双盲审查补丁并运行功能与安全测试。

question: 在 JavaScript 项目中，基于实际代码可达性筛选依赖漏洞，是否比仅基于依赖清单显著减少误报且不漏掉可利用漏洞？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Reachability cuts irrelevant vulnerability alerts without misses.
H2: Reflection, dynamic loading, and deployment differences cause false negatives.
H3: Benefits concentrate in selected dependency types or package environments.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: Not All Dependencies are Equal: An Empirical Study on Production Dependencies in NPM
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: In the studied 100 npm projects, the authors report 608 alerts across 32 projects and none concerning production dependencies; they caution project configuration does not reliably distinguish production from non-production use. This is evidence of scope-filtering opportunity, not proof a reachability scanner preserves recall.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 使用带 SBOM、调用路径和已披露漏洞的版本化项目，比较清单告警与静态/动态可达性分析的精确率、召回率和人工核验成本。

question: 面对训练知识截止日期之后公开、且不给漏洞描述的可复现漏洞，分工式安全 agent 是否比单 agent 和传统扫描器发现更多漏洞？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Teams improve search coverage and confirmed discoveries.
H2: Known clues, configuration, or duplicate findings explain gains.
H3: More agents raise cost without improving independently confirmed findings.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: Teams of LLM Agents can Exploit Zero-Day Vulnerabilities
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The paper reports vulnerability discovery/exploitation in its evaluated setting; it does not by itself establish prospective, blind discovery of genuinely post-cutoff zero-days.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 在授权的隔离靶场中按漏洞类别与项目留出，重复比较多 agent、单 agent、静态扫描器的检出率、误报和分析成本。

question: 在相同模型调用数与 token 预算下，图状通信拓扑是否比星形或链式拓扑提升协作任务完成率？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Graph communication speeds delivery of complementary information.
H2: Topology gains disappear after matching messages, tokens, and calls.
H3: Best topology varies with task dependency structure.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: MultiAgentBench: Evaluating the Collaboration and Competition of LLM agents
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The benchmark evaluates collaboration and competition across tasks and agent setups; cost-matched replication is needed before assigning gains to communication topology itself.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 固定 agent 数、模型、总 token、工具权限和任务集，随机化拓扑；按任务域和协调复杂度报告成功率及通信成本。

question: 在长程多 agent 协作中，可更新的共享计划/状态是否有帮助，还是只有允许 agent 交流并修正计划时才提高成功率？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Structured shared state improves plan retention when it can be updated during execution.
H2: A fixed or stale plan can hurt relative to acting on local observations.
H3: Communication and replanning, rather than shared state, explain the measured gains.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: AgentWorld: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Collaboration of Multi-agent LLMs
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: AgentWorld reports a shared-plan/no-communication condition at 17.6% success versus 22.9% for no communication; vanilla multi-agent communication reaches 52.0%. In this task, a fixed plan alone hurts, while communication enables adjustment. This argues against assuming that shared plans alone help.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 在相同 agent 与通信预算下，比较自由消息、结构化共享状态和混合协议，统计错误传播、角色偏离与任务成功。

question: 在动态家庭环境中，持续更新的语义地图和障碍地图能否提高长时间移动操作成功率，并减少过时地图导致的失败？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Online maps adapt to changing homes and improve task completion.
H2: Update noise offsets gains; static maps suffice in stable scenes.
H3: Relocalization/planning, not map updates, explains improvements.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: OK-Robot: What Really Matters in Integrating Open-Knowledge Models for Robotics
locators: §V.A Live semantic memory and obstacle maps
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: OK-Robot identifies static semantic and obstacle maps as an open direction; reported success varies by setting, but the paper does not test dynamic-map intervention.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 在多日家庭场景中比较静态地图、定期更新和事件触发更新，测对象检索、导航碰撞、任务完成与维护成本。

question: 在模块化移动操作机器人中，显式检测阶段失败并重试，是否能在不显著增加碰撞风险的情况下提升端到端任务成功率？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Stage-level diagnosis prevents error propagation.
H2: False recovery triggers increase task time or risk.
H3: Perception/execution limits dominate, so recovery gains are small.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: OK-Robot: What Really Matters in Integrating Open-Knowledge Models for Robotics
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: OK-Robot describes cascading component failures and calls for failure detection/recovery; it does not establish that a specific recovery policy improves safety or completion.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 使用冻结任务和硬件，比较无恢复、固定重试、基于不确定性的恢复策略，报告端到端成功率、安全事件和额外时间。

question: 以查询计划多样性引导测试，是否能在不同数据库引擎和真实工作负载上持续优于代码覆盖率引导？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Plan feedback finds more independent logic bugs across engines.
H2: Gains depend on engine/workload and shrink under held-out evaluation.
H3: Plan novelty is an unstable proxy for confirmed defects.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: Testing Database Engines via Query Plan Guidance
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The paper proposes query-plan-guided test diversity and evaluates named database engines; generalization across versions, workloads, and confirmed-bug outcomes remains a separate question.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 使用相同测试时间、查询有效率和 oracle，对多个 DBMS 及真实查询种子比较计划多样性、覆盖率与确认缺陷数。

question: 显式覆盖高层中间表示特性的测试生成，是否能在新版本深度学习编译器中持续发现覆盖引导方法遗漏的逻辑错误？
competing_hypotheses: H1: IR constraints generate low-cost, complementary tests.
H2: Yield depends on particular compiler/operator versions.
H3: Oracle and reduction quality dominate generator choice.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: Fuzzing Deep Learning Compilers with HirGen
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: HirGen studies high-level IR-guided fuzzing for deep-learning compilers; future-version evaluation is needed before claiming persistent advantage over coverage-guided methods.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 在冻结版本与后续版本上配对运行 IR 感知、随机和覆盖引导生成器，比较确认缺陷、有效图比例与复现率。

question: 针对性提示是否能稳定提升模型在未见竞赛题上的算法正确率，且收益是否超过检索与自我反思带来的提升？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Hints reveal algorithmic structure and improve hidden-test accuracy.
H2: Benefits depend on prompt quality and sampled task distribution.
H3: Retrieval or execution feedback explains more than static hints.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: Can Language Models Solve Olympiad Programming?
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The paper evaluates models on Olympiad-style programming tasks; its task distribution and evaluation conditions do not settle whether hint gains transfer to unseen problems and hidden tests.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 在按竞赛年份留出的题目上比较无提示、检索、自反思和盲化专家提示，报告通过率、提示成本和题型差异。

question: 在固定任务质量门槛下，量化、批大小和提示长度的节能收益能否跨任务、模型和 GPU 世代稳定复现？
competing_hypotheses: H1: Efficiency policies yield portable energy savings at fixed quality.
H2: Hardware and measurement boundaries change strategy ranking.
H3: Lower energy per token does not necessarily lower joules per successful task.
evidence_status: targeted full-text audit; source-located evidence; independent replication/counter-evidence search incomplete

sources.title: Towards Sustainable NLP: Insights from Benchmarking Inference Energy in Large Language Models
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The study benchmarks energy for selected LLM/task configurations; measurements are configuration-bound and motivate quality-matched, hardware-stratified replication.

sources.title: From Words to Watts: Benchmarking the Energy Costs of Large Language Model Inference
sources.role: full-text anchor; independent counter-evidence search incomplete
sources.claim: The study benchmarks energy for selected LLM/task configurations; measurements are configuration-bound and motivate quality-matched, hardware-stratified replication.

proposed_discriminating_experiment: 在固定质量阈值下做跨硬件复现，记录焦耳/任务、延迟、吞吐与准确率，控制输出长度和并发。
